mapper.sql: css.id AS id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( (SELECT description FROM crm_support_pipeline_settings WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = crm_support_pipeline_setting_id) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM crm_support_pipeline_setting_stags WHERE crm_support_stag_id = css.id ) AS pipelineSettingName, css.name AS stageName, css.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, css.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM crm_support_stags AS css LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = css.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = css.modified_by

WHERE css.is_active = 1
AND css.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_stags(name, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{stage.name}, NOW(), #{stage.createdBy}, #{stage.isActive})
